notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only lookout-specific source is the Forest Lookouts page, which gives the county and nothing else (no build date, design, height, status or staffing). The story is therefore short; about 100 words, below the 120-word target, because nothing else honest could be added. Record status unknown is correct as far as the sources go. Not in the NHLR or FFLOS Florida lists checked. Gazetteer sites name a 'Grand Ridge Lookout Tower' at about 30.7125, -84.973 but anyplaceamerica.com returned 403 and the snippet gave no status, so it was not used. A 2024 news item about a house fire in the town of Grand Ridge is unrelated and was not used. Record coordinates come from the Forest Lookouts map widget and were not checked against a second source.
